finding: CD8 T cell exhaustion score is higher in non-responder tumor samples.

method_context.analysis: cluster annotation, module scoring, and differential abundance

evidence_sources.summary: The exhaustion module score is higher in the non-responder CD8 T cell cluster.
The figure evidence passport links the plot recipe and QC note.

interpretation: The result supports an association between exhausted CD8 T cell states and poor ICI response in this cohort.
alternative_explanations: Batch composition may differ between responder groups.
The cluster may include activated cytotoxic cells rather than terminally exhausted cells.
validation_needed: Check patient-level mixed effects rather than cell-level-only tests.
Validate exhaustion markers with independent cohorts or spatial assays.
allowed_claim: Non-responder tumors show higher exhausted CD8 T cell signatures in the analyzed cohort.
